name: youtube-telegram-downloader
description: Telegram Serverless bot that downloads YouTube videos with TypeTube through a Render worker.

scripts.check: npm run check:modules && npm run check:syntax && npm run test:all
scripts.check:syntax: node --check tgcloud/handlers/message.js && node --check tgcloud/handlers/callback_query.js && node --check tgcloud/schema.js
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npx tgcloud push && npx tgcloud migrate && npx tgcloud webhook
